page_title: NOT 2-0 WHU | Nottingham Forest v West Ham 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' 2 - 0 Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home low into the middle of the net. The goalkeeper was helpless.
90+3' Nuno Espirito Santo decides to make a substitution. Morgan Gibbs-White will be replaced by Andrew Omobamidele (Nottingham).
90+3' The substitution has been made. Danny Ings (West Ham) has replaced Kurt Zouma.
90+3' Divock Origi (Nottingham) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar.
90+2' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
90+1' An attempted cross from Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is cleared. The linesman makes the right call and West Ham will have a corner.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The game is interrupted as Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is flagged offside.
90' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.

89' Divock Origi (Nottingham) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. West Ham win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
88' Nottingham have a goal ruled out for offside!
86' The corner is swung in but Nottingham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
86' Nuno Espirito Santo prepares a substitution. Nicolas Dominguez is replaced by Ryan Yates (Nottingham).
84' Nuno Espirito Santo isn't happy on the touchline after referee Thomas Bramall shows him a yellow card.
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Tomas Soucek (West Ham) is replacing Emerson.
83' Referee Thomas Bramall signals NO PENALTY for Nottingham after a VAR review!
82' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Nottingham! Let's see what he decides.
81' Neco Williams (Nottingham) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
80' A promising first-time strike from inside the box by Divock Origi (Nottingham), but his attempt goes just wide of the target.
79' Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
78' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
76' David Moyes has decided to make a change. Benjamin Johnson (West Ham) replaces Vladimir Coufal.
75' That will be all from Michail Antonio who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Maxwel Cornet (West Ham).
74' Nottingham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
71' RED CARD! Kalvin Phillips (West Ham) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Thomas Bramall. He can have an early bath.
71' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nottingham comes to nothing.
68' The yellow card is received by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham).
68' Kalvin Phillips (West Ham) earns the yellow card.
68' Thomas Bramall shows a yellow card to Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) for a tough tackle.
67' We are about to witness a subsitution. Divock Origi (Nottingham) for Taiwo Awoniyi.

64' Chance! Callum Hudson-Odoi sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker over the bar.
63' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) gets inside the box and tries to beat Matz Sels with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
61' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
60' Neco Williams (Nottingham) has received a yellow card for his foul.
57' Thomas Bramall shows a yellow card to Kurt Zouma (West Ham), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
56' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
52' Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
51' Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick.
51' Great save! Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the roof of the net was brilliantly saved by Alphonse Areola.
50' The free kick is taken by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham), but ball is cleared.
49' Kalvin Phillips (West Ham) makes a rough challenge and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The whistle blows and Thomas Bramall starts the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' The referee gives a yellow card to Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).

45+5' 1 - 0 Nicolas Dominguez produces a sweet pass and picks out Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 1:0!
45+3' West Ham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+1' Danilo (Nottingham) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
44' Michail Antonio (West Ham) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
42' The shot by Danilo (Nottingham) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Alphonse Areola.
38' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
36' Michail Antonio (West Ham) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Thomas Bramall's book.
34' Nayef Aguerd (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
32' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
31' Alphonse Areola displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
29' The ball is cleared after Michail Antonio (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
29' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards the middle of the goal and the goalkeeper makes an easy save.
28' Kalvin Phillips (West Ham) fires a volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and forces the goalkeeper to make a brilliant save.
27' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nottingham.
22' Neco Williams (Nottingham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
21' Nottingham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
20' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Nottingham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
19' Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Thomas Bramall signals.
16' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

16' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Alphonse Areola didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
15' Foul! Kurt Zouma (West Ham) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
14' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
9' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
8' Thomas Bramall shows the yellow card to Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) for a heavy challenge.
8' The ball falls kindly for Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies high over the bar.
7' The West Ham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

5' It's unbelievable, Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) blows a huge opportunity! He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific daisy-cutter from point blank range. His first-time effort is directed towards the middle of the target, but Alphonse Areola reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
4' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! West Ham will take the kick-off.
Thomas Bramall will officiate today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
